# Serenity UI

> Serenity UI (https://serenity-ui.com) is a free, open-source library of animated, interactive React components, blocks, and templates. Built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and HTML5 Canvas.

Serenity UI provides copy-paste React components and full-width UI blocks with a focus on micro-interactions, 3D perspective animations, canvas effects, and tactile feedback. All components are self-contained and compatible with the official shadcn CLI.

## Components
- [Portfolio Book](https://serenity-ui.com/components/portfolio-book): Interactive flippable sketch portfolio book component for React and Tailwind CSS with realistic page-turning physics and handwritten typography.
- [Vintage Keyboard](https://serenity-ui.com/components/vintage-keyboard): Retro mechanical typewriter and keyboard interactive simulator for React with synthesized mechanical key sounds and tactile keypress states.
- [Flame Button](https://serenity-ui.com/components/flame-button): Organic flame and particle fire button component for React featuring GPU-accelerated canvas shaders and dynamic hover glow.
- [3D Flip Card](https://serenity-ui.com/components/flip-card-3d): 3D perspective hover flip card component for React with smooth spring-animated rotational tilt and dual-sided content reveal.
- [Brand Marquee](https://serenity-ui.com/components/brand-marquee): High-performance continuous logo marquee component for React with smooth edge-fade gradient masks and pause on hover.
- [Swipe Card](https://serenity-ui.com/components/swipe-card): Interactive gesture-based swipeable stack card component for React with physics-driven drag velocity and auto-rotation.
- [3D Image Carousel](https://serenity-ui.com/components/image-carousel): Smooth 3D rotational perspective image carousel component for React with interactive dragging and depth scaling.
- [Masonry Image Gallery](https://serenity-ui.com/components/image-gallery): Modern masonry photo gallery component for React with fluid expand-to-fullscreen layout animations.
- [Tubelight Navbar](https://serenity-ui.com/components/tubelight-navbar): Apple-inspired floating tubelight navigation bar for React with smooth spring-physics glowing indicator and dark mode.
- [Typewriter Testimonial](https://serenity-ui.com/components/typewriter-testimonial): Animated typewriter customer testimonial quote card for React with realistic typing cadence and author badge.
- [Carousel 360](https://serenity-ui.com/components/carousel-360): 360-degree cylinder 3D carousel component for React with spatial depth perspective and continuous rotational dragging.

## Blocks
- [Voice Testimonial](https://serenity-ui.com/blocks/testimonial): Audio voice note testimonial section block for React featuring interactive audio waveforms, play/pause controls, and duration counters.

## Catalogs & Navigation
- [All Components](https://serenity-ui.com/components): Catalog of all interactive, animated, and 3D React components.
- [All Blocks](https://serenity-ui.com/blocks): Full-width UI sections and production blocks for React.
